name: gizza-ai/remove-control-chars
summary: Strip null bytes and non-printable control characters from text

tool.description: Remove null bytes and non-printable control characters (Unicode category Cc: U+0000–U+001F, U+007F–U+009F) from text. By default tabs (keep_tabs) and newlines/carriage returns (keep_newlines) are preserved as meaningful whitespace; set them false to strip those too. replacement is substituted for each removed character (empty string by default, which deletes it). Runs locally — the text never leaves the device.

keep_newlines.description: When true (default), keep line feed (\n) and carriage return (\r) characters. Set false to remove them too.

keep_tabs.description: When true (default), keep horizontal tab characters (\t). Set false to remove them too.

replacement.description: String to substitute for each removed control character. Defaults to an empty string, which deletes the character.

text.description: The text to strip control characters from.
